    Homogeneous maps and components #

    IsHomog μ ν h f: f maps degree g into degree g h. comp μ ν h f is the degree-h component of an A-linear map; it is A-linear (comp), homogeneous of degree h (isHomog_comp), and f is the sum of its components (sum_comp).
